purpose: The prompt template of role S's generator (D-955: the sealed OLMo model, the same family as the labeller, run in a separate sealed pass). Filled by tools/neg_synth.py render_prompt from a brief that holds structure only: no key, no outcome of the next round, no stance, no red-line mark, no rubric and none of Shimmer's prompts. The generator writes every variant of every slot; Python alone chooses which variant an item uses.

<agreed article id>.agreed_text: <the agreed text, one or two paragraphs separated by a blank line>

line_forms.party_no_notes: (no statement of this party is on record; write none for it)
line_forms.title: - {article}
line_forms.agreed: - Article {article}: text agreed by all parties. Write it in full (agreed_text).
line_forms.open_article: - Article {article}: a lead-in sentence agreed by all (chapeau), then {count} competing wording(s) still under negotiation, slots {slots}. For each slot write a wording and a revision.
line_forms.statement_article: - {slot}: {party}, round {round}, about article {article} as a whole
